exposure: Women with APAP over previous CS
Acute persistent abdominal pain (APAP) over previous cesarean scar
acute lower abdominal pain located at the site of previous caesarean scar (CS)

cohort: Pregnant women with previous cesarean delivery
finding: Acute persistent abdominal pain over a previous cesarean scar was associated with a doubled risk of uterine rupture.
mod_finding: Acute persistent abdominal pain (APAP) over a previous cesarean scar was associated with a doubled risk of uterine rupture, potentially leading to an increase in iatrogenic preterm deliveries.
